audit_name: Secure Rating Intake Engine Architecture & Integrity Validation Audit

rule_1_evaluator_authorization.requirement: Must belong to authorized evaluators set.

rule_2_pair_membership.requirement: Must match regex ^PILOT_P_\d{4}$ and exist in the frozen 200-pair manifest.
rule_2_pair_membership.failure_action: Reject submission with INVALID_PAIR_ID or UNKNOWN_PAIR error.

rule_3_duplicate_prevention.requirement: Exactly one accepted submission per pair per evaluator. Duplicate attempts are permanently rejected.

rule_4_rating_domain.requirement: Strict integer in {0, 1, 2} corresponding to No Fit, Potential Fit, and Good Fit.

rule_5_confidence_scale.requirement: Strict integer in {1, 2, 3} corresponding to Low, Medium, High confidence.

rule_6_verbatim_quote_match.requirement: Must be non-empty and a normalized verbatim substring (>= 8 chars) of the job description snippet in the manifest.

rule_7_decision_rationale_depth.requirement: Non-empty string with length >= 25 characters detailing domain matching rationale.

rule_8_mandatory_skill_justification.requirement: Non-empty string with length >= 10 characters articulating candidate alignment with required technical competencies.

rule_10_blinding_violation_defense.requirement: Strictly forbids fields containing model predictions, peer annotations, or benchmark scores.
rule_10_blinding_violation_defense.failure_action: Reject submission immediately with BLINDING_VIOLATION error.

rule_11_ledger_immutability.requirement: Every accepted submission is appended as an immutable JSON line with SHA-256 payload digest and UTC timestamp. In-place modification, deletion, or truncation is forbidden.
rule_11_ledger_immutability.failure_action: Ledger write failure or validation fault.
